title: Italian Supermarket Flyers & Deals Scraper
description: Extract current promotional products from Italian supermarket flyers. Structured products are available for supported chains; fallback results are explicitly marked.

catena.title: Supermarket chain
catena.description: Select one chain, or all currently monitored chains.

categoria.title: Product search / category filter (optional)
categoria.description: Return only records whose product name or category contains this term, for example: pasta, birra, acqua.

maxItems.title: Maximum number of products
maxItems.description: Maximum output records. The Actor returns fewer records when fewer current structured offers are available.

diagnosticMode.title: Save API diagnostics
diagnosticMode.description: Stores API response diagnostics for structured flyers. Use for development only.

investigateZeroResults.title: Investigate chains without structured products
investigateZeroResults.description: Development mode: only for chains returning zero API products, saves page HTML, screenshot, DOM audit and click/network probes to identify alternative flyer structures. Does not change extracted output.
